tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das yang gsang khros pa yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer dngos grub myur stsol bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas par khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ 'bring po yab yum rkyang sgrub/ bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa dang gsum byung ba las/ 'dir yab yum rkyang sgrub rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang / padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /padma dbang chen bsgom bzlas ni/ /bdag gi sems can don du bgyi/ /zhes tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / sems can thams cad bde dang ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal med gyur cig /sems can bde la rtag par gnas/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /ces pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi padma dbang chen du gsal bas/ oṃ raṃ badzra kro dha rakṣa dzwa la raṃ tikṇa bi shwa dzwa la/ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ raṃ a/

oṃ a ha ra a ha ra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhuppe hūm̐/ thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi te/ shapta/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza te dzwa hūm̐/ oṃ mahā padma rakta hūm̐/ zhes pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ swa bha wa bi shuddha sarba dharma swa bha wa bi shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ padma maṇḍa la/ sna tshogs padma'i lte bar/ ma surya maṇḍa la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ru tra baṃ/ bdud nag pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa sa bon gyi yig 'bru hrīḥdamar po dang / maṃ sngon por gyur/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas gsum nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum spyan drangs/ saṃ ha ra na hūm̐/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru la thim pas/ padma dmar po dang / bandha khrag gis gang ba'i rnam par gyur/ tiṣṭha badzra brtan par byas/ hrīḥm hā kro dha ha ya ghṛ wa hū lu hū lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ padma yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar nag g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba'i rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rta mgo ljang khu/ rngog ma dmar po/ phum phum ser po/ zhur dkar po/ rta skad drag po lhang lhang 'tsher ba/ smin ma dang sma ra'i ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / g.yon gyi dang po bandha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas lcags kyu/

g.yon gnyis pas rgyu ma'i zhags pa/ g.yas gsum pas tsan dan gyi be con dang / g.yon gsum pas ral gri rab tu 'bar ba 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / tshal bu'i dpung rgyan/ skam po/ rlon pa/ rid pa ste thod phreng tshar gsum gyi do shal can/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang / glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rakta'i thig le zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon pos bar snang khyab pa/ sgeg dang dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje'i rngams dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ /zhabs g.yas gnyis bskum zhing / g.yon gnyis brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ bandha khrag bkang yongs su gyur pa las/ de'i pang na yum chen padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi'i snying rlon pa bzung nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa dung chen dmar 'khyil yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ spyan gsum khrag mig tu blta ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa nag po mun pa ltar 'thibs pas sku sked yan chad non pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis spras pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ yab kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen khrag 'thung yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā padma shwa ri sa pā ri wā ra argaṃ pra titstsha ye swā hā/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhuppa/ེ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi te/ shapta pra titstsha ye swā hā/ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā his phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rang gi spyi bor hūm̐ sngon po las/ badzra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ buddha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ mtshog mar oṃ dkar po las buddha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu dzin pa/ swa ratna he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ rna ltag g.yas par swa ser po las ratna he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ paṃ padma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ltag par paṃ dmar po las padma he ru ka dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ ha karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rna ltag g.yon par ha ljang khu las karma he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de lnga ka'ang thod skam gyi khang bu re re'i nang na bzhugs pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas sngar ltar sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod dang / sngags kyi rjes su ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rakta la khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pas sman raka gtor gsum gyis mchod/ rgyas par rtags bstod dam/ bsdu na/ kun mkhyen mus srad pas mdzad/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor na/ /padma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan steng du/ /rnam shes gnas gyur padma he ru ka /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/

/rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /bde stong zung 'jug shes rab thabs dang rol/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med khro mo'i sku/ /rgyud dug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ma/ /khro mo gar dbang yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas rlung ro bus nas 'og rlung gyen du 'then pas/ rang gi lte ba nas 'od dmar zhing gsal ba sgron me stegs pa lta bu bde ba'i rang bzhin dmar khyug gis byung bas lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyis gang / sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig de nyid la sangs kyis dag 'od dmar po de nyid rna bug gnyis nas phyir sor bzhi tsam thon nas dmar lam me yod pa la sems gtad de rlung phyir thub tshad du mnan/ mi thub pa dang rlung nang du drangs pa dang mnyam du 'od sngar las kyang ches cher gsal bas lus thams cad khyab pas mun khung du sgron me stegs pa ltar/ rang nyid lha'i sku yab yum zhal sbyor spyan gyi dkar nag ma 'dres par me dpung gi dbus na gsal seng nge bzhugs pa/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam rmi lam gyi snang ba'am/ chu zla ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de/ rlung nang du ci thub 'dzin cing sems 'dzin med du 'jog de ltar yang yang bsgoms pas ting 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing / rgyas par lha khrid sems bzung gi shog dril dang / bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi shog dril/ de'i bogs 'don dug lnga lam slong gi shog dril/ gtum mo drod kyi shog dril sogs bla ma dam pa'i zhal shes kyis brgyan nas nyams khrid du byas pa la rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas rang gi thugs khar padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gyen du kha bye ba'i lte bar hrīḥ'adab ma rnams la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyi sngags 'phreng kha dog dmar nag yig 'bru gyen du langs pas bskor bar bsam/

de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa nyi ma'i 'od zer ram/ gser gyi ba thag 'dzings pa bzhin ban bun 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la sangs dag 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga dang / yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams sogs nas phyir 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad la sogs pa yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams nyer spyod lnga la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa/ sman raka gtor gsum sogs nang gi mchod pa/ sbyor ba dang sgrol ba sogs gsang ba'i mchod pa/ gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod cing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bye brag tu dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa rnams la 'od zer phog pa'i mod la tshar bcad/ thams cad dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo bo 'od zer kha dog lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang lhan cig tu mtsho la ser chen babs pa bzhin du rang la chem gyis thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam la/ hrīḥ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /thugs kar padma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar la ni snying po hrīḥ/ /'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa phul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdu/ /sems can sgo gsum sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /zhes pas gsal btab nas rig pa ma yengs pa'i ngar dang bcas pas/

hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya ghri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang / yum gyi thugs kar padma'i lte bar ma yig 'dab ma la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdu gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ mahā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ 'dzab bstod ni/ hrīḥ padma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /mi bzad khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /dbang drag stobs chen rngams brjid gtum/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'gying zhing brjid/ /dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston/ /phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod/ /zhabs bzhi 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrog /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / 'dzab kyi dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrīḥ khro rgyal dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyibs/ /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /oṃ padma ta krita padma shwa ri ma hā kro dha ha yaṃ ghri wa mā ma trag mo duntiṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ ces pa nyer gcig tsam dang / oṃ padma kro dha kā ya wakka tsitta siddhi a la la hoḥ zhes brjod pas dngos grub thams cad rang nyid kyis thob cing brtan par bsams/ de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe bar chad kyi rnam pa ci byung yang sngags kyis ngar btags te tshar bcad pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas khro chung dmar nag khro zhing rngam pa grangs med pa dang / mtshon cha rno zhing rtsub pa dang / me dpung che zhing rtsub pa 'bar ba'i 'ur sgra dang bcas pa/ nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros pas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar bcad cing / stong gsum gyi pha rol nam mkha'i mthar yud kyis bskrad nas/ sngar gyi spros pa rnams tshur 'dus rang gi mtha' skor du khro bo gur khang sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir ba/

de'i phyi mtshon cha'i gur khang / de'i phyir me dpung gi gur khang gsal btab/ de rnams las me mtshon khro bo'i tsha tsha lcags kyi zhun ma 'thor ba ltar phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ gdon bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rtsi sbur mes tshig pa'am/ me stag chu nang du shor ba ltar rjes med du song bar bsams la/ oṃ ram̐ kro dha rakṣa badzra dzwa la raṃ tikṇa bi shwa dzwa la raṃ phaṭa/ raṃ raṃ zhes mtshams sngags dang / oṃ padma shrī he ru ka mahā tsand+ra ra ga pa shang ku ru/ padma ta krita badzra kro dha ha yaṃ ghri wa tsand+ra rakṣa mahā ba la mā ma shwa raṃ/ padma kro dha hrīḥhrīḥsarba duṣṭaṃ trig nan ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa tsitta rbad nan/ myogs thum ril rbad/ hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad/ staṃ bha ya nan/ zhes pa lcags mkhar spu gri'i sngags shin tu rno zhing gnyan pa dang / oṃ padma kro dhi shwa ri badzra pā ṇi kī lā ya/ ya ma ma hā yakṣa/ kā la ru pa karmā raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ na ga du tshande tsande/ mi li mi li hūm̐ phaṭaḥces pa bde gshegs gces 'dril gyi sngags zab mo rnams thun mtshams su brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig yan bzla bar bya'o/ /thun 'jog khar lhag chad kha bkang ba dang / byin rlabs brtan pa'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzlas/ sngar ltar mchod bstod bya/ ha ya ghṛ wa hrīḥgab/ ba mo dha ya hrīḥgab/ padma bandha hrīḥgab/ tsanta rakṣa hrīḥgab/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes pas gnas lngar phyag rgya dang bcas pas lus bsrung / thun mtshams su rang dpal gyi thugs ka nas mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du thon la spyod lam gyi bya ba bya'o/ /nang du 'jug pa na sngar gyi de la thim pa bsams/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor lta bu'i tshe/ lha bsdu bar 'dod pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas yab yum gyi bar du thim/ yum yab/ yab hrīḥyig gi bar du bsdus/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar rig stong gi bar du mnyam par bzhag nas/

oṃ ma hā shu n+ye ta dzñā na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ mthar ldang bar 'dod pas/ de'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal gyis skur langs par bsams la/ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha yaṃ ghri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod mthar/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /padma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i skye tshogs thams cad la/ /rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog /ces bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyi gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas/ zhag re la thun bzhir bcad nas nyams su blang / dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug gam gsum la sogs pa yin la/ grangs ni yab la 'bum phrag bcu bzhi/ yum la de'i phyed/ rtags sam mtshan ma ni gsang rgyud las/ sku nyid dngos su mthong ba'am/ /slob dpon nyi zla mgo la 'char/ /rdzas la me 'bar 'od 'phro zhing / /snang srid me tog padmas gang / /sgrub khang g.yo 'gul sgra chen 'byung / /padma'i sdong por bdag 'dug dang / /sangs rgyas nyag gcig chos nyan pa/ /zhes sogs rnams rmi lam/ nyams snang / mngon sum du 'byung ba ni rim pa bzhin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rtags su bshad do/ /'di nyid shin tu zab cing gsang ba sgrub thag nye ba'i mthar thug pa yin zhing / khyad par snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po dang klu'i gnod pa phal cher 'byung bas/ de'i gnyen por 'di bas lhag pa med pas nan tan du nyams su blang bar bya'o// ༈ //gsang sngags snying po mahā yo ga'i bcud/ /sgrub sde brgyad kyi zab don padma gsung / /de yi mthar thug yang gsang khros pa zhes/ /o rgyan mkhan po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'dar char grub dbang brgyud par bcas pa yi/ /snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bka' babs las 'ongs yab yum bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /dngos grub myur stsol deng 'dir kho bos sbyar/

/bcom ldan 'das yang gsang khros pa yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi bsgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer dngos grub myur stsol zhes ba 'di ni/ rang gi slob bu blo dman dag la phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor pa padma drag po rtsal gyis mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi dgon par sbyar ba dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer dngos grub myur stsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
